intent: A stadium announcer reading the record book: numbers first, then the one defeat that still hurts.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, three one-line beats, punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Which country has the MOST World Cup titles?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: Which country has the most World Cup titles?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: Brazil: five titles, 1958, 1962, 1970, 1994 and 2002. Nobody else has more than four.
Brazil is also the only team at all 22 World Cups, never missing one since 1930.
Pelé won his first at 17, still the youngest champion ever.
And the one that hurt: 1950, the final lost at home in the Maracanã, nearly 200,000 watching.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
lines.text: Nobody has more stars. Follow us.
